text-align: center;"} ![](images/car-engine.png){fig-align="center" width="700"} ::: fragment "engine" ![](images/r-logo.png){fig-align="center" width="194"} ::: ::: ::: {.column style="width: 40%; text-align: center;"} ![](images/car-dashboard.png){fig-align="center" width="700"} ::: fragment "dashboard" ![](images/positron-logo.png){fig-align="center" width="194"} ::: ::: ::: ## R packages ::: incremental - **Packages** are the fundamental units of reproducible R code – they include reusable R functions, documentation of these functions, and sample data - Packages are how the community extends R - As of August 2026, there are over 24,000 R packages available on **CRAN** (the Comprehensive R Archive Network) - We're going to work with a small (but important) subset of these! ::: ## {.center} [Let's take a tour of]{.hand-blue-large} ![](images/r-logo.png){width="194"}     [and]{.hand-blue-large}     ![](images/positron-logo.png){width="194"} ## Tour recap: R and Positron
![](images/tour-r-positron.png){fig-align="center"} ## A short list (for now) of R essentials - Functions are (most often) verbs, followed by what they will be applied to in parentheses: ```r do_this(to_this) do_that(to_this, to_that, with_those) ``` . . . - Packages are installed with the `install.packages()` function and loaded with the `library` function, once per session: ```r install.packages("package_name") library(package_name) ``` ## R essentials (continued) - Columns (variables) in data frames are accessed with `$`: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dataframe$var_name ``` ::: . . . - Object documentation can be accessed with `?` ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ?mean ``` ::: ## tidyverse ::: columns ::: {.column width="40%"} ![](images/tidyverse.png) ::: ::: {.column width="40%"} ::: large [tidyverse.org](https://www.tidyverse.org/) ::: ::: incremental - The **tidyverse** is an opinionated collection of R packages designed for data science - All packages share an underlying philosophy and a common grammar ::: ::: ::: ## Acknowledgements - Photo of car engine: Image by [Davgood Kirshot](https://pixabay.com/users/photoman-115455) from [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/car-engine-prius-c-motor-vehicle-231213) - Photo of car dashboard: Image by [VariousPhotography](https://pixabay.com/users/variousphotography-1860391) from [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/car-speedometer-vehicle-dashboard-2370636) - Number of R packages: [CRAN contributed packages](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/)
